```{r}
solve_alpha = function(A, lambda) {
  f = function(alpha) {
    s = sum(pmax(alpha / A - lambda, 0))
    return(s / 2 - 1)
  }
  a = uniroot(f, c(0.0, 1000.0), tol = 1e-10)$root
  return(a)
}


bcc_transpose = function(X, # Cluster the columns while reweighting them
                         lambda,
                         gamma = 1000,
                         k = 5,
                         tmax = 30,
                         w_0 = NA) {
  n = dim(X)[1]
  p = dim(X)[2]
  if(any(is.na(w_0))) {
    w = runif(p)
  } else{
    w = w_0
  }

  w = w / sum(w)
  col_sum_sq = numeric(p)
  M = X
  for (t in 1:tmax) {
    # scaled_columns = t(t(X) * sqrt(w^2 + lambda * w))  # Equivalent, may be faster in some cases
    scaled_columns = sweep(X, 2, sqrt(w^2 + lambda * w), "*")
    D = as.matrix(dist(t(scaled_columns))) ^ 2

    nn = matrix(0, p, k) # p x k  since weighting columns
    for (i in 1:p) {  # k+1 and filter out self assignment
      neighbors = k.nearest.neighbors(i, D, k+1)
      nn[i,] = neighbors[which(neighbors != i)][1:k]
    }
    W = matrix(0, p, p)
    for (i in 1:p) {
      W[i, nn[i,]] = exp(-0.5 * D[i, nn[i,]] / n)  # TODO replace 0.5 with phi
    }

    # https://stackoverflow.com/a/74645749
    W_sum_at_nn <- cbind(apply(nn, 2, function(z) {
      W[cbind(seq_along(z), z)] + W[cbind(z, seq_along(z))]
    }))

    numer_left <- gamma * t(sapply(1:n, function(m) {
      W_sum_at_nn[m,] %*% M[,nn[m,]]
    }))
    numer_right = sweep(X, 2, w^2 + lambda * w, "*")

    denom_left = rowSums(W_sum_at_nn) * gamma
    denom_right = w^2 + lambda * w
    denom = outer(denom_left, denom_right, "+")
    
    M = (numer_left + numer_right) / denom
    M[, which(w <= 0)] = 0

    col_sum_sq = colSums((X - M)^2)
    alpha = solve_alpha(col_sum_sq, lambda)
    w = pmax(alpha / col_sum_sq - lambda, 0) / 2
  }
  return(list(M=M, w=w))
}

bcc = function(X,
               lambda,
               gamma = 1000,
               k = 5,
               tmax = 30,
               w_0 = NA) {
  n = dim(X)[1]
  p = dim(X)[2]
  if(any(is.na(w_0))) {
    w = runif(p)
  } else{
    w = w_0
  }

  w = w / sum(w)
  col_sum_sq = numeric(p)
  M = X
  for (t in 1:tmax) {
    # scaled_columns = t(t(X) * sqrt(w^2 + lambda * w))  # Equivalent, may be faster in some cases
    scaled_columns = sweep(X, 2, sqrt(w^2 + lambda * w), "*")
    D = as.matrix(dist(scaled_columns)) ^ 2

    nn = matrix(0, n, k) # n x k
    for (i in 1:n) {  # k+1 and filter out self assignment
      neighbors = k.nearest.neighbors(i, D, k+1)
      nn[i,] = neighbors[which(neighbors != i)][1:k]
    }
    W = matrix(0, n, n)
    for (i in 1:n) {
      W[i, nn[i,]] = exp(-0.5 * D[i, nn[i,]] / p)
    }

    # https://stackoverflow.com/a/74645749
    W_sum_at_nn <- cbind(apply(nn, 2, function(z) {
      W[cbind(seq_along(z), z)] + W[cbind(z, seq_along(z))]
    }))

    numer_left <- gamma * t(sapply(1:n, function(m) {
      W_sum_at_nn[m,] %*% M[nn[m,],]
    }))
    numer_right = sweep(X, 2, w^2 + lambda * w, "*")

    denom_left = rowSums(W_sum_at_nn) * gamma
    denom_right = w^2 + lambda * w
    denom = outer(denom_left, denom_right, "+")
    
    M = (numer_left + numer_right) / denom
    M[, which(w <= 0)] = 0

    col_sum_sq = colSums((X - M)^2)
    alpha = solve_alpha(col_sum_sq, lambda)
    w = pmax(alpha / col_sum_sq - lambda, 0) / 2
  }
  return(list(M=M, w=w))
}
```

```{r}
I11 = which(toss == 11)
I12 = which(toss == 12)

X = X[I, ]
toss = toss[I]
p = dim(X)[2]
for (i in 1:p) {
  X[, i] = (X[, i] - mean(X[, i])) / sd(X[, i])
}
```

```{r}

bicobra <- function(X, lambda, gamma, k, tmax) {
  n = dim(X)[1]
  p = dim(X)[2]
  U = X
  P = matrix(0, nrow=n, ncol=p)
  Q = matrix(0, nrow=p, ncol=n)
  w <- runif(p)
  w <- w/sum(w)

  for(t in 1:tmax) {
    # Do regular bcc
    bcc_1 = bcc(U + P, lambda=lambda, gamma=gamma, k=k, tmax=tmax, w_0 = w)
    Y = bcc_1$M
    w = bcc_1$w
    P = U + P - Y
    # Do transposed bcc
    bcc_2 = bcc_transpose(Y + Q, lambda=lambda, gamma=gamma, k=k, tmax=tmax, w_0 = w)
    U = bcc_2$M
    w = bcc_2$w
    Q = Y + Q - U
  }
}
```


```{r}
l=bicobra(X,lambda=0.002,k=5,gamma=10,tmax=100)
```


```{r}

solve_alpha_prox = function(D_l, nu, q, lambda) {
  D_nu = D_l / (1/nu + D_l)
  f = function(alpha) {
    s = sum(D_nu * pmax((alpha + q/nu) / D_l - lambda/2, 0))
    return(s - 1)
  }
  a = uniroot(f, c(-min(q/nu), 10000000.0), tol = 1e-10)$root
  return(a)
}


rscobra <- function(X, lambda, k=4, nu=1, gamma=10, phi=0.05, tmax=100, tol=1e-9, recalculate_weights=TRUE) {
  n = dim(X)[1]
  p = dim(X)[2]
  Q <- X
  q <- runif(p)
  q <- q/sum(q)
  for(t in 1:tmax) {
    if(recalculate_weights || t==1) {
      wts = gkn_weights(t(Q), k_row=k, k_col=k, phi=phi)
      w_row <- wts$w_row
      w_col <- wts$w_col
      E_row <- wts$E_row
      E_col <- wts$E_col
    }

    # Cobra has rows as features, columns as samples
    cobra_result <- cobra(t(Q), E_row, E_col, w_row, w_col, gamma=gamma, max_iter=tmax)

    # print(Q)
    if(sum((t(cobra_result$U[[1]]) - Q)^2) < tol) {
       Q <- t(cobra_result$U[[1]])
       break
    }
    
    Q <- t(cobra_result$U[[1]])
    for(t2 in 1:tmax) {  # Coordinate wise minima of biconvex optimization
      # Solve for Q with fixed w
      w_sq <- q^2 + lambda * q
      X_weighted <- sweep(X, 2, w_sq / (1/nu + w_sq), "*")
      Q_weighted <- sweep(Q, 2, 1 / (1 + nu * w_sq), "*")
      Q <- Q_weighted + X_weighted
      
      # Solve for w with fixed U
      col_sum_sq = colSums((X - Q)^2)
      alpha = solve_alpha_prox(col_sum_sq, nu, q, lambda)
      new_q = (col_sum_sq) / (col_sum_sq + 1/nu) * pmax((alpha + q/nu) / col_sum_sq - lambda/2, 0)
      
      if(sum((new_q - q)^2) < tol) {
        q = new_q
        break
      } 
      q = new_q
    }
  }
  
  return(list(U=Q, w=q))
}
```

```{r}
plot_matrix <- function(mat) {
  df <- as.data.frame(mat) |>
    mutate(row_num = row_number()) |>
    pivot_longer(!row_num, names_to="col_num") |>
    mutate(col_num = str_replace(col_num, "V", ""))
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x=col_num, y=row_num, fill=value)) +
    geom_raster() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(breaks = seq(-3, 3, 0.25)) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x=element_blank(), 
      axis.ticks.x=element_blank()
    )
}

plot_matrix(l$U)
```
